name: Evaluate Free Tool Growth
summary: Evaluate whether a free utility can create genuine user value and a measurable acquisition loop.
description: Evaluate and scope a free calculator, checker, generator, template, or interactive utility as a growth product. Use when a team is considering engineering a free tool for discovery, lead qualification, education, or product adoption.
refuses: It does not gate the core result behind surprise lead capture.
It does not present estimates as professional, legal, medical, or financial determinations.
It does not recommend a thin clone or mass-generated utility with no distinct user value.
